title: Cross-cohort benchmarking of frozen Geneformer and expression pseudobulk for donor-level SLE classification
description: Code, donor-level results, source tables, editable multi-panel figures, and manuscript assets for a donor-level, source-only cross-cohort benchmark of frozen Geneformer and expression pseudobulk in systemic lupus erythematosus. Version 1.0.2 adds a fold-scaled, nested-regularization internal sensitivity analysis, cohort-characteristic tables, exact Geneformer extraction details, and calibrated interpretation of external prediction scores.
